cases.name: unchanged-color
cases.condition: The change type is UNCHANGED; the function desaturates color regardless of whether diffRoles is defined and never reads diffRoles.
cases.outcome: Desaturates color regardless of whether diffRoles is defined and never reads diffRoles.
cases.domain: any color string and either an omitted or defined diffRoles

cases.name: unspecified-color
cases.condition: The change type is CHANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED; the function desaturates color regardless of whether diffRoles is defined and never reads diffRoles.
cases.outcome: Desaturates color regardless of whether diffRoles is defined and never reads diffRoles.
cases.domain: any color string and either an omitted or defined diffRoles

cases.name: added-table-mode
cases.condition: The change type is ADDED and diffRoles is defined; the function returns diffRoles.added as-is and discards color.
cases.outcome: Returns diffRoles.added as-is and discards color.
cases.domain: any color string and any defined diffRoles object

cases.name: modified-table-mode
cases.condition: The change type is MODIFIED and diffRoles is defined; the function returns diffRoles.modified as-is and discards color.
cases.outcome: Returns diffRoles.modified as-is and discards color.
cases.domain: any color string and any defined diffRoles object

cases.name: deleted-table-mode
cases.condition: The change type is DELETED and diffRoles is defined; the function returns diffRoles.deleted as-is and discards color.
cases.outcome: Returns diffRoles.deleted as-is and discards color.
cases.domain: any color string and any defined diffRoles object

cases.name: added-rotate-mode
cases.condition: The change type is ADDED and diffRoles is undefined; the function returns rotateHue(color, 300).
cases.outcome: Returns rotateHue(color, 300).
cases.domain: any color input, including hex strings and non-hex strings

cases.name: modified-rotate-mode
cases.condition: The change type is MODIFIED and diffRoles is undefined; the function returns rotateHue(color, 60).
cases.outcome: Returns rotateHue(color, 60).
cases.domain: any color input, including hex strings and non-hex strings

cases.name: deleted-rotate-mode
cases.condition: The change type is DELETED and diffRoles is undefined; the function returns rotateHue(color, 180).
cases.outcome: Returns rotateHue(color, 180).
cases.domain: any color input, including hex strings and non-hex strings

cases.name: desaturated-rotate-input
cases.condition: In rotate mode, color is fully desaturated; rotation is the identity, so ADDED, MODIFIED, and DELETED all produce the same color string.
cases.outcome: In rotate mode, rotation is the identity, so ADDED, MODIFIED, and DELETED all produce the same color string.
cases.domain: any fully desaturated color input

cases.name: non-hex-color
cases.condition: color is not a hex string; the function performs no validation, and desaturate or rotateHue returns it unchanged when reached, while table mode ignores it entirely.
cases.outcome: Performs no validation, returning a non-hex color unchanged when desaturate or rotateHue is reached and ignoring it entirely in table mode.
cases.domain: any non-hex color string

cases.name: empty-resolved-diagram
cases.condition: resolved contains no nodes, edges, groups, or annotations; the result remains an empty diagram and its canvas is carried through unchanged.
cases.outcome: Returns an empty diagram and carries the canvas through unchanged.

cases.name: node-with-mapped-change
cases.condition: A resolved node has an entry in overlay.nodes; its shape is replaced with recolorShape's result and its typography with recolorTypography's result for that entry's change type.
cases.outcome: Replaces the node's shape and typography with recolorShape and recolorTypography results for its mapped change type.
cases.domain: any supported node change type

cases.name: node-without-map-entry
cases.condition: A resolved node's id is absent from overlay.nodes; it is treated as UNCHANGED without throwing, and its shape and typography are recoloured accordingly.
cases.outcome: Treats the node as UNCHANGED without throwing and recolours its shape and typography accordingly.
cases.domain: any node id absent from overlay.nodes

cases.name: group-with-mapped-change
cases.condition: A resolved group has an entry in overlay.groups; its shape and typography are replaced using the entry's change type.
cases.outcome: Replaces the group's shape and typography using recolouring results for its mapped change type.
cases.domain: any supported group change type

cases.name: group-without-map-entry
cases.condition: A resolved group's id is absent from overlay.groups; it is treated as UNCHANGED without throwing, and its shape and typography are recoloured accordingly.
cases.outcome: Treats the group as UNCHANGED without throwing and recolours its shape and typography accordingly.
cases.domain: any group id absent from overlay.groups

cases.name: edge-with-mapped-change
cases.condition: A resolved edge has an entry in overlay.edges; its connection is replaced with recolorLine's result and its typography with recolorTypography's result for that entry's change type.
cases.outcome: Replaces the edge's connection and typography with recolour results for its mapped change type.
cases.domain: any supported edge change type

cases.name: edge-without-map-entry
cases.condition: A resolved edge's id is absent from overlay.edges; it is treated as UNCHANGED without throwing, and its connection and typography are recoloured accordingly.
cases.outcome: Treats the edge as UNCHANGED without throwing and recolours its connection and typography accordingly.
cases.domain: any edge id absent from overlay.edges

cases.name: annotation-recoloured-as-unchanged
cases.condition: A resolved annotation is present; no overlay map is consulted, and it is always passed as UNCHANGED through recolorShape, recolorLine for its callout, and recolorTypography, desaturating its carried colours.
cases.outcome: Does not consult an overlay map and recolours the annotation's shape, callout, and typography as UNCHANGED, desaturating its colours.
cases.domain: any resolved annotation

cases.name: mixed-element-types
cases.condition: resolved contains any combination of nodes, edges, groups, and annotations; each element uses its own type-specific styling fields and map, while annotations always use UNCHANGED.
cases.outcome: Recolours each element using its type-specific fields and map, while always treating annotations as UNCHANGED.
cases.domain: any finite combination of the four element types

cases.name: mixed-change-types
cases.condition: Different mapped nodes, edges, or groups have different change types; each element is recoloured using the change type found by its own id rather than a shared per-element resolution.
cases.outcome: Recolours each mapped element using the change type associated with its own id.
cases.domain: any finite set of map entries with supported change types

cases.name: single-diff-role-resolution
cases.condition: The tokens input is used to resolve diff roles once before walking the elements, and that single result is passed to every recolour call, preventing per-element palette-mode mixing.
cases.outcome: Resolves diff roles once from tokens before the walk and passes that shared result to every recolour call.
cases.domain: any resolved diagram with zero or more recoloured elements

cases.name: optional-tokens-omitted
cases.condition: The optional tokens argument is omitted; the function still accepts the call and applies the recolouring pipeline using the recolour helpers' token behavior.
cases.outcome: Accepts an omitted tokens argument and applies recolouring using the helpers' default token behaviour.

cases.name: canvas-untouched
cases.condition: resolved has a canvas, including alongside recoloured elements; the returned canvas is the original canvas value and is not recoloured.
cases.outcome: Carries the original canvas value through without recolouring it.
cases.domain: any canvas value

cases.name: element-nonstyle-fields-preserved
cases.condition: Elements contain fields such as id, parentGroup, layout, label, content, anchor, isSuperNode, or hiddenDescendantCount; all such non-styling fields are carried through untouched while only the declared styling fields are replaced.
cases.outcome: Carries all non-styling element fields through unchanged while replacing only the declared styling fields.
cases.domain: any values of the listed non-styling fields

cases.name: resolved-input-not-mutated
cases.condition: After applying the palette, the input resolved diagram and its element data remain unchanged; the function returns a copy with replaced styling fields.
cases.outcome: Leaves the input diagram and its element data unchanged and returns a copy with recoloured styling fields.
cases.domain: any resolved diagram

cases.name: tokens-undefined
cases.condition: The optional tokens argument is undefined; the function immediately returns undefined without attempting resolution.
cases.outcome: It immediately returns undefined without attempting resolution.

cases.name: all-three-resolve
cases.condition: tokens is defined and all three references, $roles.diff_added, $roles.diff_modified, and $roles.diff_deleted, resolve successfully; this includes role values that one-hop resolve through references such as $palette.green. The function returns DiffRoles containing the three resolved literal values.
cases.outcome: It resolves all three references, including one-hop palette references, and returns a DiffRoles containing the three literal values.
cases.domain: any defined token map in which all three diff-role references resolve

cases.name: one-role-unresolved
cases.condition: tokens is defined and exactly one of the three diff-role references cannot be resolved. resolveTokensIn returns a list of length 1, so the function returns undefined rather than filling the unresolved property.
cases.outcome: It returns undefined because any single unresolved role causes the all-or-none resolution to fail.
cases.domain: which one of the three diff roles is unresolved

cases.name: two-roles-unresolved
cases.condition: tokens is defined and exactly two of the three diff-role references cannot be resolved. resolveTokensIn returns a list of length 2, so the function returns undefined.
cases.outcome: It returns undefined because two unresolved roles produce a non-empty unresolved-reference list.
cases.domain: which two of the three diff roles are unresolved

cases.name: all-three-unresolved
cases.condition: tokens is defined and none of the three diff-role references can be resolved. resolveTokensIn returns a list of length 3, so the function returns undefined.
cases.outcome: It returns undefined because all three unresolved references produce a list of length three.

cases.name: accepted-colour-string
cases.condition: A colour string that rotateHue accepts is converted to the same colour's lightness with saturation set to zero, then returned as a lowercase #rrggbb string.
cases.outcome: Converts an accepted colour to zero saturation while preserving lightness and returns it as lowercase #rrggbb.
cases.domain: any string accepted by rotateHue

cases.name: already-grey-colour
cases.condition: An accepted colour whose red, green, and blue channels are already equal keeps those channel values in VALUE while the returned string is normalized to lowercase.
cases.outcome: Preserves the equal channel values and normalizes the accepted colour to lowercase.
cases.domain: any accepted grayscale colour

cases.name: uppercase-hex-input
cases.condition: An accepted uppercase or mixed-case hexadecimal colour is returned in lowercase hexadecimal notation.
cases.outcome: Returns an accepted uppercase or mixed-case hexadecimal colour in lowercase notation.
cases.domain: any accepted hexadecimal colour containing uppercase letters

cases.name: rejected-string
cases.condition: A string that rotateHue rejects is returned byte-for-byte unchanged, including its original casing and characters.
cases.outcome: Returns a rejected string byte-for-byte unchanged, including its casing and characters.
cases.domain: any string rejected by rotateHue

cases.name: accepted-saturated-color-rotation
cases.condition: A six-digit hexadecimal sRGB string with nonzero HSL saturation is parsed, its hue is advanced by the finite degrees value modulo 360, and the result is emitted as lowercase #rrggbb with channels rounded to the nearest integer.
cases.outcome: Parses the accepted six-digit sRGB color, advances its HSL hue by degrees modulo 360, and returns lowercase #rrggbb with channels rounded to the nearest integer.
cases.domain: a string matching /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/ whose saturation is greater than zero, with any finite degrees

cases.name: accepted-zero-degree-rotation
cases.condition: An accepted six-digit hexadecimal color rotated by zero degrees keeps its color value, subject to the required lowercase output normalization and channel formatting.
cases.outcome: Returns the accepted color unchanged in value, normalized to lowercase with the required #rrggbb formatting.
cases.domain: any accepted six-digit hexadecimal color

cases.name: accepted-full-turn-rotation
cases.condition: An accepted six-digit hexadecimal color rotated by a whole number of full turns has the same color value, subject to the required lowercase output normalization and channel formatting.
cases.outcome: Returns the accepted color unchanged in value after any whole-number full turn, normalized to lowercase with the required #rrggbb formatting.
cases.domain: any accepted six-digit hexadecimal color and any degrees value congruent to 0 modulo 360

cases.name: negative-degree-modulo
cases.condition: A negative finite degrees value is reduced modulo 360 before the hue rotation.
cases.outcome: Reduces the negative finite degrees value modulo 360 before rotating the hue.
cases.domain: any negative finite number

cases.name: over-360-degree-modulo
cases.condition: A finite degrees value above 360 is reduced modulo 360 before the hue rotation.
cases.outcome: Reduces the finite degrees value above 360 modulo 360 before rotating the hue.
cases.domain: any finite number greater than 360

cases.name: uppercase-accepted-color
cases.condition: An accepted hexadecimal color containing uppercase letters is parsed normally and always emitted in lowercase, even if rotation does not change its color channels.
cases.outcome: Parses the uppercase-containing accepted color normally and returns it in lowercase even when its channels do not change.
cases.domain: any accepted six-digit hexadecimal color containing one or more uppercase hexadecimal letters

cases.name: achromatic-color-identity
cases.condition: An accepted fully desaturated color has no hue to advance and is returned as the same color value for every finite rotation angle, with lowercase output normalization.
cases.outcome: Returns an accepted fully desaturated color unchanged in value for every finite angle, with lowercase output normalization.
cases.domain: any accepted six-digit hexadecimal color whose HSL saturation is zero

cases.name: three-digit-hex-rejected
cases.condition: A three-digit hexadecimal color string is rejected and returned byte for byte without parsing, transformation, or lowercasing.
cases.outcome: Returns the three-digit hexadecimal string byte for byte without parsing, transformation, or lowercasing.
cases.domain: a three-digit hex string such as #abc

cases.name: named-color-rejected
cases.condition: A named color string is rejected and returned byte for byte without parsing, transformation, or lowercasing.
cases.outcome: Returns the named color string byte for byte without parsing, transformation, or lowercasing.
cases.domain: a named color such as none

cases.name: unresolved-color-rejected
cases.condition: An unresolved role or token reference is rejected and returned byte for byte without parsing, transformation, or lowercasing.
cases.outcome: Returns the unresolved role or token reference byte for byte without parsing, transformation, or lowercasing.
cases.domain: an unresolved reference such as $roles.node_fill

cases.name: empty-color-rejected
cases.condition: An empty string is rejected and returned byte for byte without parsing, transformation, or lowercasing.
cases.outcome: Returns the empty string byte for byte without parsing, transformation, or lowercasing.

cases.name: other-invalid-color-rejected
cases.condition: Any string that does not match the exact six-digit hexadecimal pattern is rejected and returned identically, byte for byte, without an error or lowercasing.
cases.outcome: Returns any string outside the exact six-digit hexadecimal pattern identically, byte for byte, without error or lowercasing.
cases.domain: any string not matching /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/

cases.name: empty-input
cases.condition: The target diagram and all three delta maps are empty; the result is an empty overlay.
cases.outcome: Returns an empty overlay with empty diagram maps and change-type maps.

cases.name: target-elements-copied-unchanged
cases.condition: The target contains nodes, edges, and/or groups, and no applicable delta entry changes them; every target key is copied and recorded UNCHANGED.
cases.outcome: Copies every target node, edge, and group into the new overlay and records each as UNCHANGED.
cases.domain: any subset of node, edge, and group keys

cases.name: existing-key-nondelete-change
cases.condition: A delta entry for an existing target key has change type ADDED, MODIFIED, or UNCHANGED; the target element is retained without applying the entry's after value, and that change type is recorded.
cases.outcome: Retains the target element without applying after and records the entry's ADDED, MODIFIED, or UNCHANGED type.
cases.domain: one of: ADDED, MODIFIED, UNCHANGED; one of: node, edge, group

cases.name: absent-key-nondelete-skipped
cases.condition: A delta entry with change type ADDED, MODIFIED, or UNCHANGED names a key absent from the target; the entry is skipped and neither an element nor a change-type entry is created.
cases.outcome: Skips the entry without creating an element or change-type record.
cases.domain: one of: ADDED, MODIFIED, UNCHANGED; one of: node, edge, group

cases.name: deleted-element-with-before
cases.condition: A DELETED node, edge, or group entry has before set; that before element is restored under its key and DELETED is recorded.
cases.outcome: Restores before under the key and records the element as DELETED.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group

cases.name: deleted-element-without-before
cases.condition: A DELETED node, edge, or group entry has before unset; the entry is skipped because there is no element to restore.
cases.outcome: Skips the deletion because there is no element to restore.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group

cases.name: unspecified-change-skipped
cases.condition: A delta entry has CHANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED; it is skipped regardless of its key or element fields.
cases.outcome: Skips the entry regardless of its key or element fields.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group

cases.name: restored-edge-with-finished-endpoints
cases.condition: A deleted edge is restored and both values of its own source and target fields name keys present in the finished union diagram's nodes map; the edge remains in the overlay and is recorded DELETED.
cases.outcome: Keeps the restored edge and records it as DELETED.
cases.domain: any restored edge whose two endpoint keys are present after all entries are applied

cases.name: restored-edge-missing-endpoint
cases.condition: A deleted edge is restored but its own source or target names a key absent from the finished union diagram's nodes map; the edge is dropped and receives no change-type entry.
cases.outcome: Drops the restored edge and records no change type for it.
cases.domain: a missing source, a missing target, or both

cases.name: edge-between-restored-deleted-nodes
cases.condition: A deleted edge refers to nodes that are also restored from their DELETED entries; endpoint validation occurs after all entries are applied, so the edge survives.
cases.outcome: Keeps the deleted edge because its restored endpoints are present in the finished union.

cases.name: restored-parent-preserved
cases.condition: A restored deleted node or group has parentGroup set to a key present in the finished union diagram's groups map; its parentGroup is retained.
cases.outcome: Retains the restored element's parentGroup when that group exists in the finished union.
cases.domain: one of: node, group

cases.name: restored-parent-missing-cleared
cases.condition: A restored deleted node or group has parentGroup set to a key absent from the finished union diagram's groups map; the element is kept but parentGroup is unset as undefined, not set to an empty string.
cases.outcome: Keeps the restored element but sets its missing parentGroup to undefined.
cases.domain: one of: node, group

cases.name: deleted-group-deleted-members-restored
cases.condition: A deleted group and members that are themselves reported DELETED are restored; those restored members carry their before.parentGroup values and rejoin the group.
cases.outcome: Restores each deleted member with its before.parentGroup so it rejoins the restored group.
cases.domain: any number of deleted members

cases.name: deleted-group-modified-members-stay-current
cases.condition: A deleted group has a member reported MODIFIED; that member remains the target's current element and parentGroup is not changed back to its old group.
cases.outcome: Leaves each modified member at its target version and does not restore its former parentGroup.
cases.domain: any number of modified members

cases.name: deleted-group-with-surviving-members
cases.condition: A deleted group has members that survive in the target rather than being reported DELETED; the group is restored as an empty group because surviving members are not reparented.
cases.outcome: Restores the group without reparenting surviving members, so it renders empty.
cases.domain: any number of surviving members

cases.name: target-remains-unmutated
cases.condition: The target contains any graph content while mergeDelta is applied; the returned diagram is a new value and target is not mutated.
cases.outcome: Builds and returns a new overlay without mutating the target diagram.
cases.domain: any target diagram

cases.name: annotations-not-merged
cases.condition: The inputs or surrounding document contain annotations in the stylesheet; annotations are outside Diagram and Delta, so mergeDelta copies or changes none of them.
cases.outcome: Ignores annotations because they are outside Diagram and Delta.
cases.domain: any annotation entries

cases.name: nondeleted-color-recolor
cases.condition: A Glyph1D has a stroke whose paint is the color case and/or a glow with a set color, and change is any ChangeType other than DELETED. Each such color is replaced with diffColorFor of its current value; no ghosting edit is made.
cases.outcome: Returns an unmutated copy with each set solid stroke and glow color replaced by diffColorFor, without changing dashing.
cases.domain: any non-DELETED ChangeType; any color values and either or both color-bearing properties

cases.name: deleted-stroked-glyph
cases.condition: A Glyph1D has a stroke and change is DELETED. Its applicable stroke and glow colors are recolored, and stroke.dashing is set to STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED regardless of its prior dashing; the stroke is not otherwise changed.
cases.outcome: Returns an unmutated copy with applicable set solid colors recolored and the existing stroke's dashing set to STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED while all other stroke properties remain unchanged.
cases.domain: any stroked Glyph1D, any prior dashing, and any supported color configuration

cases.name: deleted-strokeless-glyph
cases.condition: A Glyph1D has no stroke and change is DELETED. No stroke is created; any existing glow color is still recolored.
cases.outcome: Returns an unmutated copy without creating a stroke, while recoloring any set glow color.

cases.name: unset-stroke-color
cases.condition: The glyph has a stroke whose paint is the unset paint case. That stroke color remains unset rather than being passed through diffColorFor; if change is DELETED and the stroke exists, only its dashing is changed to dotted.
cases.outcome: Leaves an unset stroke color unset and, when deleted, changes only the existing stroke's dashing to STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED.
cases.domain: any existing stroke with an unset paint color

cases.name: gradient-stroke-paint
cases.condition: The glyph has a stroke whose paint is a gradient. The gradient is left unchanged rather than recolored; DELETED still changes the existing stroke's dashing to dotted.
cases.outcome: Leaves a gradient stroke paint unchanged and, when deleted, sets the existing stroke's dashing to STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED.
cases.domain: any stroke gradient

cases.name: unset-glow-color
cases.condition: The glyph's glow color is unset. It remains unset rather than being passed through diffColorFor.
cases.outcome: Leaves an unset glow color unset.
cases.domain: any Glyph1D with an unset glow color

cases.name: gradient-glow-color
cases.condition: The glyph's glow color is a gradient. The gradient is left unchanged rather than being recolored.
cases.outcome: Leaves a gradient glow color unchanged.
cases.domain: any Glyph1D with a gradient glow color

cases.name: copy-preserves-noncolor-style
cases.condition: For every input, recolorLine returns a copy without mutating glyph and carries through stroke.width, stroke.cap, stroke.join, glow.radius, glow.intensity, and both arrowhead variants and their size unchanged; Glyph1D has no fill, so DELETED does not create a fill or alter opacity.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy without mutating the glyph, preserving all specified noncolor stroke, glow, and arrowhead styling and creating no fill or opacity change for deletion.
cases.domain: any Glyph1D and any values of the carried-through style fields

cases.name: color-stroke-paint
cases.condition: The glyph has a stroke whose paint is the color case and whose color is set; the returned copy replaces stroke.color with diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with the set color-case stroke color replaced by diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.domain: any set stroke color

cases.name: gradient-stroke-paint
cases.condition: The glyph has a stroke whose paint is the GRADIENT case; the stroke, including its gradient data, is left unchanged and no color is derived.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy leaving the gradient stroke and all its gradient data unchanged without deriving a color.

cases.name: color-fill-paint
cases.condition: The glyph has a fill whose paint is the color case and whose color is set; the returned copy replaces fill.color with diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with the set color-case fill color replaced by diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.domain: any set fill color

cases.name: gradient-fill-paint
cases.condition: The glyph has a fill whose paint is the GRADIENT case; the fill, including its gradient data, is left unchanged and no color is derived.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy leaving the gradient fill and all its gradient data unchanged without deriving a color.

cases.name: glow-color-set
cases.condition: The glyph has a glow with its color set; the returned copy replaces glow.color with diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with the set glow color replaced by diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.domain: any set glow color

cases.name: decoration-colors-set
cases.condition: The glyph has one or more decorations with color set; every such decoration has its color replaced with diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with every set decoration color replaced by diffColorFor of its prior value.
cases.domain: any number of decorations with colors

cases.name: optional-colors-unset
cases.condition: One or more optional color fields that would otherwise be considered (stroke.color, fill.color, glow.color, or a decoration color) are unset; each remains unset and no color is invented.
cases.outcome: Leaves every unset optional color field unset and does not invent a color for it.
cases.domain: any subset of applicable optional color fields

cases.name: deleted-with-stroke
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has a stroke; the returned copy sets stroke.dashing to STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED, discarding the prior dashing while preserving the rest of the stroke.
cases.outcome: For DELETED, returns a copy whose existing stroke dashing is STROKE_PATTERN_DOTTED while preserving the rest of the stroke.
cases.domain: any existing stroke and any prior dashing

cases.name: deleted-without-stroke
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has no stroke; no stroke is created and therefore no dashing is added.
cases.outcome: For DELETED, returns a copy without creating a stroke or adding dashing.

cases.name: deleted-fill-explicit-opacity
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has a fill with opacity set; the returned copy sets fill.opacity to its prior value multiplied by 0.4.
cases.outcome: For DELETED, returns a copy whose existing fill opacity is its prior value multiplied by 0.4.
cases.domain: any explicitly set fill opacity

cases.name: deleted-fill-unset-opacity
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has a fill whose opacity is unset; it is treated as 1.0 and the returned copy sets fill.opacity to 0.4.
cases.outcome: For DELETED, treats the present fill's unset opacity as 1.0 and sets it to 0.4 in the copy.

cases.name: deleted-without-fill
cases.condition: change is DELETED and the glyph has no fill; no fill is created and no opacity is set.
cases.outcome: For DELETED, returns a copy without creating a fill or setting opacity.

cases.name: nondeleted-preserves-ghosting-fields
cases.condition: change is any value other than DELETED; existing stroke.dashing and fill.opacity are left untouched, including when the stroke or fill is absent.
cases.outcome: For every non-DELETED change, leaves existing stroke dashing and fill opacity untouched, including absent fields.
cases.domain: any non-DELETED change type

cases.name: copy-preserves-geometry-and-style
cases.condition: For any supported glyph and change, recolorShape returns a copy without mutating the input; shape_kind, corner_radius, stroke dimensions and joins, glow dimensions and intensity, and the listed decoration identity, kind, text, icon, and position fields are carried through unchanged.
cases.outcome: Returns an independent copy without mutating the input, carrying all specified geometry and non-edited style and decoration fields through unchanged.
cases.domain: any supported glyph

cases.name: both-colors-set
cases.condition: Typography has both color and background set; each current color is replaced with diffColorFor of that value, while all other typography fields are carried through unchanged.
cases.outcome: Returns a copy with both color and background replaced by diffColorFor of their current values while all other typography fields remain unchanged.
cases.domain: any Typography with both optional colours present

cases.name: color-unset
cases.condition: Typography has no color value but has a background value; the unset color remains unset and the background is replaced with diffColorFor of its current value.
cases.outcome: Leaves color unset and replaces the set background with diffColorFor of its current value.
cases.domain: any Typography with color unset and background set

cases.name: background-unset
cases.condition: Typography has a color value but no background value; the color is replaced with diffColorFor of its current value and the unset background remains unset.
cases.outcome: Replaces the set color with diffColorFor of its current value and leaves background unset.
cases.domain: any Typography with color set and background unset

cases.name: both-colors-unset
cases.condition: Typography has neither optional color set; both optional colors remain unset and the remaining typography fields are carried through unchanged.
cases.outcome: Leaves both colors unset and carries the remaining typography fields through unchanged.
cases.domain: any Typography with both optional colours unset

cases.name: non-deleted-change
cases.condition: The change type is any non-DELETED change type; recoloring is applied to the typography colours without ghosting, and font, size, weight, align, and visible are unchanged.
cases.outcome: Recolors the typography colors without ghosting and leaves font, size, weight, align, and visible unchanged.
cases.domain: any non-DELETED ChangeType

cases.name: deleted-change
cases.condition: The change type is DELETED; the typography colours are recolored like any other change, with no ghosting or additional treatment of the label.
cases.outcome: Recolors the typography colors as usual without ghosting or any additional label treatment.

cases.name: diff-roles-omitted
cases.condition: No diffRoles argument is supplied; the function still applies diffColorFor to each set colour and preserves unset optionals and all non-colour typography fields.
cases.outcome: Applies diffColorFor to each set color, preserves unset optionals and non-color fields, and returns a copy when diffRoles is omitted.

cases.name: diff-roles-supplied
cases.condition: A diffRoles argument is supplied; the function uses it as part of the diff-color computation while still returning a copy and preserving the typography fields that are not colours.
cases.outcome: Uses the supplied diffRoles in computing diff colors while returning a copy and preserving all non-color typography fields.
cases.domain: any supplied DiffRoles value

cases.name: input-not-mutated
cases.condition: For every supported combination of typography colours, change type, and optional diff roles, the input Typography object is not mutated; the returned value is a recolored copy.
cases.outcome: Returns a recolored copy without mutating the input Typography for any supported colors, change type, or diff roles.
cases.domain: all supported function inputs

cases.name: ordinary-successful-render
cases.condition: A valid target diagram, delta, stylesheet, theme bindings, and layout engine pass through merge, binding seeding, resolution, diff palette application, layout, and SVG rendering successfully, producing an SVG string.
cases.outcome: Runs all six stages in order and returns the successfully rendered SVG string.
cases.domain: any valid renderable diagram and delta

cases.name: empty-delta
cases.condition: The delta contains no changes, so the merged overlay represents the target without diff changes and the pipeline renders it successfully.
cases.outcome: Merges the unchanged target and successfully renders it without diff changes.
cases.domain: an empty delta

cases.name: undefined-stylesheet
cases.condition: The stylesheet argument is undefined; stage 2 uses a newly created empty Stylesheet with schemaVersion 1 before resolving and rendering.
cases.outcome: Creates an empty schemaVersion-1 Stylesheet for stage 2, then resolves, lays out, and renders successfully.

cases.name: stylesheet-with-default-theme-binding
cases.condition: The stylesheet binds a theme under the reserved binding name default; themes.get('default') supplies that bound theme for component seeding and diff roles, regardless of the theme's literal name.
cases.outcome: Uses the theme bound to default, regardless of its literal name, for component seeding and diff roles.
cases.domain: any theme bound to default

cases.name: stylesheet-without-theme-bindings
cases.condition: The stylesheet binds no themes; resolveThemes supplies the default binding using the documented fallback [['default', 'dark']], which is then used for default component and diff styling.
cases.outcome: Uses the resolveThemes fallback default binding of [['default', 'dark']] for default components and diff styling.

cases.name: multiple-theme-bindings
cases.condition: The stylesheet binds a default theme and one or more additional themes; the additional bindings style their own elements while the default binding alone determines the whole-picture diff mode and roles.
cases.outcome: Uses each additional binding for its elements while the default binding alone selects whole-picture diff mode and roles.
cases.domain: a stylesheet with two or more theme bindings

cases.name: merged-deleted-element-with-component-kind
cases.condition: The delta causes a deleted element to be present in the merged overlay, and that element has a kind such as database; seeding after merge assigns its component from the bound theme vocabulary so it renders consistently with surviving elements.
cases.outcome: Seeds the merged deleted element from the bound theme's kind vocabulary so it renders consistently with surviving elements.
cases.domain: a deleted or restored element whose kind maps to a theme component

cases.name: resolve-pipeline-failure
cases.condition: resolvePipeline fails for the merged union diagram and seeded stylesheet; the returned PipelineError is propagated unchanged, including the resolvePipeline-provided stage name.
cases.outcome: Propagates the resolvePipeline PipelineError unchanged, including its stage name.
cases.domain: any resolvePipeline failure

cases.name: layout-failure
cases.condition: Resolution and diff palette application succeed, but layoutEngine.layout returns an error; the function returns an Err with stage layout.
cases.outcome: Returns an Err with stage layout when layoutEngine.layout fails.
cases.domain: any layout engine failure

cases.name: render-failure
cases.condition: All earlier stages including layout succeed, but SvgRendererImpl().render fails; the function returns an Err with stage render.
cases.outcome: Returns an Err with stage render when SVG rendering fails.
cases.domain: any SVG renderer failure
